taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-31 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 2792.1 | 0.92 | 0.92
2 | 1847.0 | 0.49 | 1.41
3 | 2743.7 | 1.01 | 2.42
4 | 1318.3 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-31
Curve type: HK
Aquifer depth: > 2.42 m
Recommendation: Drill past the shallow resistive top layers to target the lower-resistivity basal formation starting at 2.42 m depth. Advance drilling sufficiently into Layer 4 while logging cuttings to confirm yield and water quality.
